clips.send: Fold the plane along the x -axis: (3, 2) lands on (3, negative2) . Only the sign of y flips. Fold along the y -axis instead and only the sign of x flips: (negative3, 2) .

clips.send: Order matters! (2, 3) means across 2 , up 3 , which is a completely different spot. Same two numbers, different point.
clips.text: Order matters! (2, 3) means across 2 , up 3 , which is a completely different spot. Same two numbers, different point.

clips.send: The axes cut the plane into four quadrants, numbered I to IV going counterclockwise. The signs of the two coordinates tell you the quadrant at a glance. Points on an axis belong to no quadrant.

clips.send: So add a second number line, stood upright, crossing the first one at 0 . The horizontal line is the x -axis, the vertical one is the y -axis, and they meet at the origin O .

clips.send: Common mix-up: In the ordered pair (x, y) the x-coordinate always comes first. (2, 5) and (5, 2) are different points! Also, a point on an axis, like (0, 4), is not in any quadrant.

clips.send: A single number line gives every point on it an address: this dot lives at 3 . But a map is flat. If the dot floats up off the line, one number can no longer say where it is.

clips.send: Negative numbers just mean the other direction: a negative x goes left, a negative y goes down. So (negative4, 1) is left 4, up 1, and (negative2, negative3) is left 2, down 3.

clips.send: To reach the dot from O : go across 3 , then up 2 . We write its address as the ordered pair (3, 2) : the x -coordinate first, the y -coordinate second.

clips.send: 所以再加一条数轴，把它竖起来，和第一条在 0 处相交。水平的叫 x 轴，竖直的叫 y 轴，两轴的交点叫原点 O 。

clips.send: 两条坐标轴把平面分成四个象限，按逆时针方向依次叫第一、二、三、四象限。看两个坐标的正负号，就能马上判断点在哪个象限。坐标轴上的点不属于任何象限。

clips.send: 顺序很重要！ (2, 3) 表示向右 2 、向上 3 ，这是完全不同的位置。同样两个数，却是不同的点。

clips.send: 沿格线求距离： A(负5, 3) 和 B(3, 3) 的纵坐标相同，所以只要横着数。到 y 轴有 5 个单位，再走 3 个： AB 等于 8 。（也就是 3 减 (负5) 等于 8 。）

clips.send: 沿 x 轴把平面对折： (3, 2) 落在 (3, 负2) 上，只有 y 的符号变了。如果沿 y 轴对折，就只有 x 的符号改变，得到 (负3, 2) 。

clips.send: 一条数轴能给轴上的每个点一个“地址”：这个点在 3 的位置。可地图是平面的。如果点离开数轴往上飘，只用一个数就说不清它在哪儿了。

clips.send: 负数只是表示反方向： x 为负就向左， y 为负就向下。所以 (负4, 1) 是向左 4、向上 1; (负2, 负3) 是向左 2、向下 3。
